answer: Agents must ferry a unique tarnished coin from the wharf to the reef’s island shrine in under 11 seconds; any duplicate coinage collapses the bridge’s tide lock, resetting every ferry to a new wharf-side queue. A Sybil spawns an extra coin only after another 11-second serial slog—the reef’s tidal queue is indivisible and unclonable, so each fake costs an 11-second delay, no batch lanes allowed.
